assessment: File coverage is close to complete: every source file under crates/, apps/desktop/src-tauri, apps/desktop/web-rs/src, docs/ and .github/ fell inside one of the 26 slices, and the only partially read regions are test tails (core/scoping.rs tests, graph sharepoint.rs test module), CHANGELOG entry bodies, both Cargo.lock files, and ~20 bindings files that were parity-scanned rather than read. The blind spots are lenses, not files, and the repo shows concrete evidence for each: (1) concurrency across run kinds — cancel_bulk's doc (bulk.rs:125-135) asserts audit and bulk "never run at once" while audit_cancel is claimed in six command files and CancelFlag::cancel deliberately stops every older generation, so cross-kind collateral cancellation is plausible and unexamined; (2) launch-time duplication — Home mounts five LocalResources at sign-in and list_credential_expirations re-pages all of /applications with its own $select instead of reading the app index, alongside the search-corpus prefetch and F007's ungated list; (3) error UX end to end — the frontend branches on ~6 of ~30 UiError codes, reads `retryable` at one site, auth emits `network` while every client emits `network_error`, `throttled` has no rendering, and only the Graph client sets a connect_timeout; (4) install-format-blind updater — check_for_update/perform_update have no MSI/.deb gate although the README says MSI is not auto-updated and the Linux updater only supports AppImage, plus the unsigned-macOS + keychain-ACL question; (5) observability — one `error!` and 65 `warn!` across the backend, no Graph request-id/client-request-id capture (Exchange transport is the lone model), no frontend log persistence, diagnostics commands are cache-only; (6) the ~300 inline tests in the desktop crate could not be executed and nobody assessed whether they would have caught the ~20 confirmed bugs in the same files. Category-wise, perf is under-represented (10 of 439) and several backend findings imply frontend work nobody scoped (F027/F058 exchange unavailability, F059/F178 truncation, F035 terminal events, F073 dead UI branch, F094 revoke UI, F127/F402 marker groups) while F376/F377 need backend DTO changes — the judge should pair these across areas.
